name: Minecraft Server
tagline: Your own Minecraft world, always on.
description: The canonical homelab game server. Native arm64; instantly understood by non-techies.
postInstall: This one has no web page — you join it from the Minecraft client. Connect to <app>.<cluster-id>.internal on port 25565 over your tailnet, or <app>.lan.<cluster-id>.internal from your local network if you turned LAN access on. <app> is the name you gave this install; <cluster-id> is your cluster's id.
